title: Candida albicans infection
protocol: Make a frozen stock of subcultures of _Candida albicans_ at -80°C in Sabroud Dextrose Broth containing 15% glycerol.
Plate cultures on Sabouraud dextrose agar plates and grow at 37°C for 24 hours.
Pick a colony from a plate and grow in 5 ml of Sabouraud Dextrose Broth in a 14 ml conical tube at 37°C for 24 hours in a shaker.
Centrifuge the cells (1000 rpm for 5 minutes).
Wash the pellet twice with 5 ml of sterile PBS and resuspend in PBS.
Count the cell number using a hemocytometer.
Inject 2-5 × 10^5 colony-forming units of _C. albicans_ dissolved in 200 μl of sterile PBS from tail vein to induce disseminated candidiasis.
